„Eigener Workspace\" = Toggl-Clients wer: "Own workspace" = Toggl clients become customers and projects become projects. "As a single customer" = the entire workspace becomes exactly one customer; each internal Toggl client (the company's end customer) is created as an external customer and the projects reference it — this preserves the end-customer separation. Existing customers/external customers/projects are reused by name (no duplicates).
